## Five development lanes

The owner requested at least five lanes on 2026-10-10. All five have specialist assignments; the execution pool permits three workers alongside the persistent captain, so completed or waiting lanes yield to the next independent work. Each contribution has its own paths/worktree and exact-source acceptance. The captain integrates shared interfaces and runs package/release gates.

| Lane | Owner | Work and allowed paths | Current evidence / next gate |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 · Native runtime | native_supervisor; native_perf_review · GPT-6 Astra Ultra | Native PTY/process adapter and standalone provider acceptance | Strict Codex/Claude source and installed clean candidate proof passed; speed, wrap and origin-margin repairs integrated after independent approval; macOS/Linux source checks pass; final archive/provider/hosted gates active |
| 2 · Managed IRC | managed_irc_channels; project_routing_review | Pinned Ergo projects, stable thread accounts and opt-in product acceptance | Two-project/three-thread native product journey passed 152/152 at repaired `66a5d68`; missing-authority registration replay refused; independent recovery review passed 28 rejection + 4 recovery cases; final captain/package gates active |
| 3 · Installer and package | captain; linux_runtime; native_perf_review | Installer controls, release/runtime harnesses and exact archives | Clean `db94705` Linux arm64 native8/installer16/smoke and macOS actual native providers passed; schema1 compatibility passed; harness cancellation/public-link proof strengthened; final integrated archives pending |
| 4 · Terminal UX and docs | terminal_ux; captain | Selected runtime/repair affordance, three terminal-size captures, canonical guides and static site | Five reviewed UX/docs contributions integrated; 39 terminal captures and 16 actual responsive browser observations; current project guide updated; final site/Pages deployment separate |

Switcher/inbox refinement and owned real Mattermost qualification have integrated evidence. The captain owns shared contracts, daemon/CLI/transport wiring, manifests, release qualification and integration. Workers publish contracts before dependencies and edit separate paths/worktrees. No worker may alter the frozen v0.1.0 tag or release binaries.

Tasks are implementation milestones, not shipped feature claims. Split them into small issues before parallel assignment. BP-008 remains an early experiment even while local terminal alpha is developed.

Historical terminal acceptance was frozen at `4b36f4d773a31388c7ec8ade146eb1929a8d2a19`; its later test/document commits retained an empty implementation diff. Native acceptance checkout `498abebb` was implementation-equivalent and records its own executable/harness digests. Subsequent evidence qualifies only its stated exact source and environment. See STATUS before interpreting any task as accepted. Closing the bounded local core issues does not close full alpha, remote federation or communication work.
